scoring_justification: Recomputing DFT total energies in the verifier is infeasible; scoring relies on structural ordering of formation energies, plus a loose absolute value tolerance check against paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold paper-reported Frenkel formation energies for absolute tolerance check
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Supporting Information Table S10 and main text: CdSe Cd-Frenkel 3.16 eV, Se-Frenkel 6.00 eV; PbSe Pb-Frenkel 3.30 eV, Se-Frenkel 3.80 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact formation energies reported in the paper; used as reference.

outputs.description: Frenkel defect formation energies for cation and anion vacancies in CdSe and PbSe.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will evaluate the reported defect formation energies against undisclosed physics-based criteria.

steps.description: Verify structural ordering: CdSe_Frenkel_Se > CdSe_Frenkel_Cd and PbSe_Frenkel_Se > PbSe_Frenkel_Pb.
Check absolute formation energy values within ±1.0 eV of paper-reported gold.
